post.description: Submits a compression job for `paths` in the logs input, into `dataset`. The paths are relative to the logs-input mount point, with a leading `/` that denotes the mount point itself. The job compresses each path at its lexically normalized location under the mount point (a symlink is compressed through its own path, not its target's), and records the paths relative to the mount point. Only the clp-s storage engine with filesystem logs input is supported.

400.description: The request body isn't valid JSON; the package's storage engine isn't clp-s or its logs input isn't on the filesystem; `paths` is empty; or a path resolves to outside the logs-input mount point through a symlink

404.description: A path doesn't exist, or has a component that is too long

422.description: The request body doesn't match the schema, including when a field has the wrong JSON type, `paths` is missing, a path doesn't start with `/`, has a `..` component, or contains a NUL character or a line break, `dataset` isn't a valid dataset name, `timestamp_key` is empty, or the body has an unknown field

500.description: The logs-input mount point can't be resolved, a path can't be resolved (e.g., it's a symlink loop, or due to a permission error), the database request failed, or the inserted job's ID is out of range

get.description: Gets the timestamp column names for a given dataset (CLP-S only).

parameters.name: dataset_name
parameters.description: The name of the dataset whose timestamp column names to get.

get.description: Gets the metadata of the 1000 most recent compression jobs (most recent first), with the display fields of each job's config. Display fields stored as `null` are omitted. Returns 500 if any of the jobs' stored configs can't be decoded, including when the config, one of its sections, or one of its display fields has an unexpected type.
Gets the names of all datasets. Returns an empty list for the CLP storage engine, which has no datasets.
Gets ingestion details (timestamp range, file count, message count) across all datasets. Returns `null` when no data has been ingested yet.

Gets the query speed (total uncompressed bytes scanned and job duration) for a query job across the given datasets. For the CLP storage engine, the dataset names are validated but otherwise ignored. Returns `null` when the job doesn't exist, the job has no tasks over the datasets' archives, the job hasn't finished yet, or no datasets are given for CLP-S. Returns 404 when any of the datasets doesn't exist for CLP-S.

parameters.name: datasets
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of dataset names. For the CLP storage engine, the names are validated
but otherwise ignored.

parameters.name: query_job_id
parameters.description: The query job ID whose scan speed should be computed.

200.description: The query speed, or `null` when the job doesn't exist, has no tasks over the datasets' archives, or hasn't finished yet, or when no datasets are given for CLP-S.

400.description: Invalid dataset name, missing or malformed `query_job_id`, or unknown query parameter

get.description: Gets aggregated space-savings statistics (total uncompressed and compressed sizes) across all datasets.

Gets the earliest and latest log entry timestamps across the given datasets. For the CLP storage engine, the dataset names are validated but otherwise ignored. Returns `null` when the datasets have no archives, including when no datasets are given for CLP-S. Returns 404 when any of the datasets doesn't exist for CLP-S.

parameters.name: datasets
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of dataset names. For the CLP storage engine, the names are validated
but otherwise ignored.

200.description: The time range, or `null` when the datasets have no archives, including when no datasets are given for CLP-S.

400.description: Invalid dataset name, or unknown query parameter

get.description: Lists the entries of the directory at `path` in the logs input. `path` and the returned entries' `parent_path` are relative to the logs-input mount point, with a leading `/` that denotes the mount point itself; `parent_path` is `path` lexically normalized. Returns an empty list if `path` isn't a directory. Entries whose names aren't UTF-8 or contain a line break are omitted, since no logs-input path can address them. Only the clp-s storage engine with filesystem logs input is supported.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description:
The logs-input path of the directory to list: relative to the logs-input mount point, with
a leading `/` that denotes the mount point itself.

200.description: The directory's entries, in no particular order, or an empty list if `path` isn't a directory; entries whose names aren't UTF-8 or contain a line break are omitted

400.description: The query string is malformed (e.g., `path` is repeated); `path` is missing, doesn't start with `/`, has a `..` component, or contains a NUL character or a line break; the query has an unknown parameter; the package's storage engine isn't clp-s or its logs input isn't on the filesystem; or `path` resolves to outside the logs-input mount point through a symlink

404.description: `path` doesn't exist, or has a component that is too long

500.description: The logs-input mount point can't be resolved, or `path` can't be resolved or read (e.g., it's a symlink loop, or due to a permission error)

200.description: The URI to fetch the results of the submitted query.

delete.description: Cancels a previously submitted query job.

200.description: The cancellation request was submitted successfully.

404.description: No query job with the given ID was found.

409.description: The query job with the given ID has terminated without being cancelled.

get.description: Streams the results of a previously submitted query as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

parameters.name: raw_docs
parameters.description:
When `true`, each SSE event contains the raw result document from the results cache
serialized as JSON (including metadata such as the timestamp and the original file path);
otherwise, each event contains only the log message. Only applies to query jobs whose
results are buffered in `MongoDB`.

parameters.name: sorted

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of query results. Each event contains a single line of the query result in JSON format.

post.description: Extracts a JSON stream file that contains the log event at `log_event_idx` in the archive with ID `archive_id`. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported. If the results cache already has such a stream file, returns its metadata directly; otherwise submits an extraction job, waits for it to finish, and returns the metadata of the stream file it extracted. The wait is bounded by `api_server.stream_file_extraction_timeout_secs`; the job keeps running when the timeout is reached.

400.description: The request body isn't valid JSON, the package's storage engine isn't clp-s, or `log_event_idx` exceeds `i64::MAX`

404.description: The extraction job succeeded, but none of the archive's stream files contains the log event

422.description: The request body doesn't match the schema, including when a field has the wrong JSON type, `archive_id` isn't a UUID, `log_event_idx` is negative, `dataset` isn't a valid dataset name, or the body has an unknown field (e.g., `extract_job_type`)

500.description: The extraction job failed, was killed, was cancelled, or disappeared from the query jobs table before it finished; or a database, results-cache, or S3 request failed

504.description: The extraction job didn't finish within `api_server.stream_file_extraction_timeout_secs`

get.description: Gets resource usage statistics for compression jobs within the given time range.

parameters.name: time_range_begin_millisecs
parameters.description: Start of usage window (epoch milliseconds, inclusive).

parameters.name: time_range_end_millisecs
parameters.description: End of usage window (epoch milliseconds, exclusive).

parameters.name: job_status
parameters.description:
Job statuses to include as a comma-separated list (e.g.
`job_status=succeeded,failed`). Recognized values (case-insensitive):
`PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `KILLED`.
Defaults to `SUCCEEDED,FAILED,KILLED` (all terminal states).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. Must be > 0; defaults to 1000.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g., time_range_begin_millisecs > time_range_end_millisecs, missing required fields)

CompressionJob.description: Response body of the compression-job submission endpoint.

job_id.description: The ID of the submitted compression job.

CompressionJobCreation.description: Request body for the compression-job submission endpoint.

dataset.description:
The dataset to compress the logs into. Defaults to the default dataset when absent or
`null`.

paths.description:
The logs-input paths of the files and directories to compress: relative to the logs-input
mount point, with a leading `/` that denotes the mount point itself. Must not be empty.

timestamp_key.description: The key of the log events' timestamp field.

unstructured.description: Whether the logs are unstructured. Defaults to `false` when absent or `null`.

CompressionMetadata.description: The metadata of a compression job, with the display fields of its config.

_id.description: The compression job's ID. Named `_id` to match the `WebUI`'s existing JSON contract.

clp_config.description:
The display fields of the job's stored config. All other fields, including storage
credentials, are dropped.

compressed_size.description: Total compressed archive size, in bytes.

duration.description: Wall-clock duration the job ran, in seconds. `null` if the job did not complete.

start_time.description: Time the job started executing (RFC 3339). `null` if the job hasn't started.

status.description:
Current status of the job, as the integer value of a
[`clp_rust_utils::job_config::CompressionJobStatus`].

uncompressed_size.description: Total uncompressed size of input files, in bytes.

update_time.description: Time the job was last updated (RFC 3339).

CompressionMetadataDisplayConfig.description:
The display subset of a stored compression job config, as returned in
[`CompressionMetadata::clp_config`].

Decoding a stored config into this type keeps only the display fields: all other fields,
including storage credentials, are dropped.

input.description:
The display fields of the config's `input` section. Empty if the stored config has no
`input` section.

output.description:
The display fields of the config's `output` section. Empty if the stored config has no
`output` section.

CompressionMetadataDisplayInput.description:
The display fields of a stored config's `input` section. Older compression jobs may have stored
only some of them, and a field stored as `null` is omitted.

dataset.description: The dataset the logs were compressed into.

keys.description: The S3 object keys to compress.

path_prefix_to_remove.description: The prefix removed from the compressed file paths.

timestamp_key.description: The key of the log events' timestamp field.

CompressionMetadataDisplayOutput.description:
The display fields of a stored config's `output` section. Older compression jobs may have stored
only some of them, and a field stored as `null` is omitted.

target_archive_size.description: The target archive size, in bytes.

target_dictionaries_size.description: The target dictionaries size, in bytes.

target_encoded_file_size.description: The target encoded file size, in bytes.

target_segment_size.description: The target segment size, in bytes.

CompressionUsage.description: Resource usage statistics for the compression job with the specified ID.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Total compressed archive size, in bytes.

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock duration the job ran, in seconds. Absent if the job did not complete.

num_tasks.description: Number of tasks the job was split into.

tasks_duration_secs.description: Sum of all task durations, in seconds. Absent if no tasks reported a duration.

time_begin_millisecs.description: Time the job started executing (epoch milliseconds).

time_creation_millisecs.description: Time the job was created (epoch milliseconds).

uncompressed_size_bytes.description: Total uncompressed size of input files, in bytes.

DirEntry.description: An entry of a directory in the logs input.

is_expandable.description:
Whether the entry is a directory, or a symlink to a directory under the logs-input mount
point, which the `WebUI`'s path picker can expand.

parent_path.description: The logs-input path of the directory that contains the entry.

QueryConfig.description: Defines the request configuration for submitting a search query.

buffer_results_in_mongodb.description:
Whether to buffer search results in `MongoDB`.
By default, search results are buffered in temporary files. When set to `true`, results
will be stored in `MongoDB` instead.

count_by_time_bucket_size_millisecs.description:
The size of each time bucket (in milliseconds) for count-by-time aggregation.
When set, the job is submitted as a count-by-time aggregation job instead of a plain
search job, and its results are always buffered in `MongoDB`.

datasets.description: The datasets to search within. If not provided, only `default` dataset will be searched.

ignore_case.description: Whether the string match should be case-insensitive.

max_num_results.description: The maximum number of results to return. Omit for no limit.

query_string.description: The search query as a KQL string.

time_range_begin_millisecs.description: The beginning timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) for the search range (inclusive).

time_range_end_millisecs.description: The ending timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) for the search range (inclusive).

query_results_uri.description: The uri to get the query results.

QuerySpeed.description: Query-speed statistics for a query job.

bytes.description: Total uncompressed size of the archives the job scanned, in bytes.

duration.description: Wall-clock duration the job ran, in seconds.

total_compressed_size.description: Total compressed size of all archives, in bytes.

total_uncompressed_size.description: Total uncompressed size of all archives, in bytes.

StreamFileExtraction.description: Request body for the stream-file extraction endpoint.

archive_id.description: ID of the archive to extract the JSON stream from.

dataset.description:
The dataset of the archive to extract the stream from. Defaults to the default dataset when
absent or `null`.

log_event_idx.description: Index of the log event that the extracted stream file must contain.

StreamFileMetadata.description: The metadata of an extracted stream file.

begin_msg_ix.description: Index of the first log event in the stream file (inclusive).

end_msg_ix.description: Index after the last log event in the stream file (exclusive).

is_last_chunk.description: Whether this is the stream's last chunk.

path.description:
Where the `WebUI` fetches the stream file from: a pre-signed URL that's valid for one hour
when stream output is stored on S3, or a path under the `WebUI`'s `/streams` static mount
otherwise.

stream_id.description: ID of the stream the file was extracted from.

TimeRange.description: Earliest and latest log entry timestamps across the selected datasets.
